bio.text: Don Parsons was first elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 1994, represents House District 44 and chairs the Energy, Utilities & Telecommunications Committee.
Parsons has lived in Cobb County since 1972, graduated from West Virginia State University, and worked in the telecommunications industry for 35 years.
Parsons served 16 years in the U.S. Army Reserves and Army National Guard.
